thread:
harry: quick flag from onboarding: astara-9b int4 snapshot shows headline-summary BLEU drop ~18% vs fp16 on our news benchmark. small repro attached.
mira: can you paste the exporter command + conversion log? any warnings?
harry: exporter v0.10.1 --recipe awq-4bit --preserve-specials false (accidental). log: 
```
WARNING: appended 2 unicode sentinels to vocab tail; remapped collisions by +2
WARNING: emitted quant snapshot without mappings.json
```
jin: preserve-specials false? that seems risky we normally keep exact special token ordering. odd that mappings.json missing.
olivia: missing mappings will bite. did you run tokenizer sanity afterwards? e.g. check <sep>/<eos> ids align with embedding table.
harry: tokenizer check: 
```
tokenizer.encode("<sep>") -> 40012
embeddings.index_of("<sep>") -> 40014
```
harry: two-id offset for some sentinels. interestingly, the evaluation divergence is much worse on longer prompts (>=400 tokens).
mira: longer prompts amplify KV cache indexing issues if token ids shift -- rotary phase application could be hitting wrong positions. which rotary scheme is this model using?
jin: astara header shows mixed headwise rotary scales + alternate freq order (we use per-head freq permutation for perf). header snippet: 
```
rotary_heads: 12
rotary_freq_perm: [0,2,1,3,4,6,5,7,8,10,9,11]
rotary_scale_per_head: [1.0,0.85,0.85,1.0,0.9,0.9,1.0,0.95,0.95,1.0,0.88,0.88]
```
jin: if token ids shift, the kvcache columns and the applied rotary freqs might be off-by-n, producing subtle but systematic attention errors for long contexts.
olivia: also check if exporter reordered tokenizer merges (we had a bug where normalization nfkc run twice produced different codepoints and created duplicate-like tokens). could be unicode-normalization vs tokenizer vocab mismatch.
harry: I reran a quick smoke: after applying a manual mapping (shift -2 for those two sentinels) rouge-L recovered ~95% of gap on short prompts but long prompts still underperform by ~8%.
mira: that suggests a second issue beyond sentinel mapping. run kv-index trace with streaming simulation. add instrumentation: log kv cache column mapping for first 512 tokens and rotary index applied.
jin: I'll add a small tool to validate: it will replay token ids through the convert pipeline and assert that the rotary index used for position t matches expected permuted head mapping. if mismatch -> fail.
olivia: also try alternative quant recipes: awq-4bit-per-tensor symmetric vs per-channel. sometimes lower-rank layers benefit from per-tensor on long-context tasks.
harry: on it. current plan: 1) hotfix snapshot with mapping.json and republish (harry) 2) run awq per-tensor vs per-channel ablation on 200 samples long-context (mira) 3) kv-index + rotary-index trace instrumented run (jin) 4) add exporter CI assertion that mappings.json exists and tokenizer special ids equal embedding indices (olivia).
ci-bot: created artifact: gs://redwood-onboard/astara/1719999998/quick-repro.tar.gz :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: noted: exporter teams notified (cc @exporter-team)
mira: one more thought if exporter appended unicode sentinels, those are sometimes multi-byte in tokenizer normalization and may shift multi-byte sequences differently across platforms. add nfkc check in conversion pipeline.
harry: ack. i'll update thread with results from ablation. thanks folks :heart:
